scope: Consolidated financial-domain evidence using already frozen target-free predictions
heldout_limitation: The 478-product legacy test outcomes were opened by historical workflows; this is not pristine confirmation.

primary_comparison.m1: M0 plus 12 source terms and 24 evidence-state mechanisms
primary_comparison.metric: MAE of log10 real monthly transaction price
primary_comparison.support_rule: positive M0-minus-M1 MAE reduction, bootstrap 95% CI above zero, and two-sided p below 0.05

secondary_stabilized_predictor.weight_selection: Choose w from 0.00 to 1.00 in 0.01 steps by minimum MAE on repeated OOF development predictions only
secondary_stabilized_predictor.role: secondary robustness analysis only; it cannot replace the frozen primary M1

mechanism_checks: M1 versus text-only baseline in nested development evaluation
M1 versus row-permuted mechanism block in nested development evaluation
M1 versus text-only baseline on the fixed external replication
